messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT detected: GPU pool eu-west-1 at 97% GPU utilization. Autoscaler attempted scale but hit provider quota (8 -> 8). Queue growth observed for realtime-requests and batch-ingest. Customer impact: increased 429s and >2s tail latencies for some tenants. Paging oncall.

maria-oncall: saw the bot. I'm on it. pulling graphs now.

raj-sre: pinging. can you confirm which pool/assets are saturated? is this multiple AZs or single pool?

maria-oncall: looks like pool-eu-west-1-g4x (single pool) is the hot spot. autoscale logs show repeated provisioning errors with provider code: QUOTA_EXCEEDED. snippet:

```
2026-03-15T18:10:32Z autoscaler: scale_up failed: insufficient_quota (requested:2, available:0)
2026-03-15T18:10:36Z hostmgr: queue_length=432 pending_tokens=1.2M
```

maria-oncall: queue growth jumped at 18:06 UTC after a burst from tenant:sales-demo.tenant-id

leo-infra: confirmed provider quota is the blocker. I can request emergency quota bump but that takes ~20-30min depending on provider. we can also failover jobs to pool-eu-west-1-spot which has capacity but lower SLO (risk of preemption).

sasha-support: customer-facing: we have inbound tickets from two enterprise customers reporting 429s and slow responses. they flagged production errors at 18:12. we should send a short status update once we have mitigation.

raj-sre: immediate mitigations: 1) enable manual burst on dedicated backup pool 2) shed low-priority batch work 3) bump eviction aggressiveness for unused KV caches. who can run these now?

leo-infra: I can enable manual burst to pool-eu-west-1-spot and open a policy to route non-SLA traffic there. doing step 1 now.

deploy-bot: deploy started: route-policy update -> non-sla -> pool-eu-west-1-spot (pr: 5634). ETA ~45s.

maria-oncall: starting low-priority job purge. running:

```
> curl -X POST https://infra-api/internal/queues/purge -d '{"selector":"priority<30","limit":500} '
```

maria-oncall: purge kicked off. dropping ~310 pending jobs so far. queue length falling to 210.

ben-product: heads-up — sales-demo tenant triggered large batch test at 18:05. was this a scheduled job or unexpected? we should contact them to avoid repeating during incident.

sasha-support: I'll message the account owner and post a brief note: "We're mitigating elevated error rates in eu-west-1. Some requests are being routed to lower-SLO spot capacity temporarily. We'll update within 30m." :thumbsup:

raj-sre: monitoring: rate of 429s dropping after purge + routing. autoscaler still reporting quota errors but system load now within safe thresholds. hold for provider response on quota.

leo-infra: provider acknowledged emergency quota request. they estimate 18-45min. opened ticket REF-34921. continuing with manual burst; will watch preemption signals.

maria-oncall: adding runbook actions: set autoscaler fallback window to 60s -> immediate fallback to compatible model-quantized variants when unavailable.

maria-oncall: also captured logs and annotated for postmortem. assigning follow-ups: (1) infra: permanent quota increase request + automation to alert earlier when quota < 2 nodes. owner: leo-infra. (2) autoscaler: add better transitive fallback to spot pools and degrade non-sla traffic earlier. owner: raj-sre. (3) product: tenant abuse guard rails for large ad-hoc batch jobs. owner: ben-product.

ben-product: ack. I'll reach out to sales-demo to get context and schedule a throttle if needed.

sasha-support: sent initial customer update. will coordinate follow-ups once we confirm timeline.

maria-oncall: update in 10. current state: manual burst active, low-priority purge completed, 429s trending down. keeping the channel open for 30m to verify stability. tagging oncall rotation: @next-oncall please join if this persists beyond hour.

deploy-bot: route-policy update completed: non-sla -> pool-eu-west-1-spot applied.

raj-sre: adding temporary dashboard pins for postmortem: queue length, 99th latency, autoscaler error rate, provider quota status.

maria-oncall: closing the active pager for now. reopening if error rate > 0.5% or queue growth resumes. will kick off formal postmortem doc and link here when ready. thanks everyone.

sasha-support: noted. customers updated. thanks team.

leo-infra: provider increased quota by +4 GPUs (temporary). monitoring for preemptions.

maria-oncall: final note: incident classification: capacity-exhaustion -> autoscaler-provision-failure -> partial customer impact (elevated 429s). immediate mitigations: manual failover to spot, job purge, quota request. long-term action items recorded. assigning postmortem owner: raj-sre. expected doc by 2026-03-17.

raj-sre: will own postmortem. will include timeline, root cause (quota + one-tenant burst), and follow-up action items. planning retrospective with infra and product on Monday.
